market_view: VIX moderate at 18.7; crude fell about 8% on US-Iran easing, yields near highs, and a chip rout hit Seoul and US chips. No broad stress regime.

oil_gas.catalyst: none: 'Oil Slides, European Gas Falls as US-Iran Tensions Ease' (dars.gov.et) removes the supply-shock case
oil_gas.reasoning: XOM horizon ended about 2026-07-27 and de-escalation with a crude slide was the exit trigger. Exit and stay flat; the supply premium is unwinding and no new catalyst is named.

gold_miners.reasoning: Gold is below its 200-day average and 23% off its high, yields are high and the dollar firm. No NEM-specific catalyst in the headlines.

chips.catalyst: none: 'AMD, Intel and Micron extend losses as chip stocks get clobbered' (CNBC) is a sector move, not an NVDA catalyst
chips.reasoning: NVDA fell 5% in a sector rout and volatility is high. A drop is not a catalyst and rebound guessing is not allowed. The NVIDIA alliance blog is not a financial catalyst.

pharma.catalyst: none: generic drug tariffs from 2028 and the FDA peptide compounding panel do not target LLY near-term
pharma.reasoning: No LLY-specific unpriced catalyst; the stock is up 41% in 60 days with retatrutide news already priced.

copper_uranium.catalyst: none for FCX: 'Cameco gets UBS upgrade' (Yahoo Finance) concerns CCJ, which is not the leader
copper_uranium.reasoning: FCX has no catalyst; copper rose modestly and FCX is up 6.7% in 5 days. The harness trades only the leader, and an analyst upgrade is thin.

would_change_my_mind: A named company-specific catalyst for a leader (guidance raise, approval, export rule change) or a renewed Iran supply shock.

handoff.what_changed: US-Iran tensions eased and WTI fell 7.5% (Brent 88), so the XOM long is closed at its horizon end. Chips were clobbered (NVDA -5%, SK Hynix -10%). Cameco received a UBS upgrade; generic drug tariffs are planned from 2028.

oil_gas.why: XOM horizon ended about 2026-07-27 and crude slid on Iran de-escalation, so exit and no new catalyst.

gold_miners.why: Gold bearish below its 200-day average with high yields and no NEM catalyst.

chips.why: NVDA fell in a sector rout with no NVDA-specific catalyst.

pharma.why: No unpriced LLY catalyst; tariff news is distant and not LLY-specific.

copper_uranium.why: No FCX catalyst; the Cameco upgrade is for a non-leader.
